title: Holiday Periods — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: One date of a holiday. A holiday lasting three days has three holiday periods. The time engine treats the date as a public holiday for employees whose duty period uses the holiday's calendar.

fields.label: Holiday
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Holiday master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The holiday.

Example. Eid al-Fitr

fields.label: HolidayDate
fields.html:
What it is. The date of the holiday.

Example. 2026-03-20

Why it matters. A holiday can have each date once.
